description: Defines an interface `IPluginStarter` for starting plugins, including a method `activatePlugin` that attempts to activate a plugin with retries and delay.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An interface for starting Thunder plugins, with a method to activate plugins with retry logic.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Attempts to activate a Thunder plugin, retrying up to `maxRetries` times with a delay `retryDelayMs` between attempts.
